claim: Declares that a scene is a montage and which kind, which changes its whole shape — shot lengths, cut rate, whether music carries it and whether dialogue is allowed at all. An author reaches for it to compress weeks of training or a journey into twenty seconds without hand-authoring every fragment.
not_visual: A montage is a multi-shot form whose entire meaning lives in accumulation and cutting rhythm; one still is one fragment of it and cannot show that fragments repeat, escalate or span time. The option names are also content descriptions rather than looks, so any clause that tried to render them (sweat and exhaustion for training, luggage and platforms for travel) would rewrite what the subject is doing and where he is, breaking the rule that the subject sentence is identical in every panel and that the clause expresses only the option.
